Question: Under what three conditions will a vendor record be made inactive?
Answer:
- A vendor record will be made inactive if:
  - The vendor is Approved
  - The vendor is Unapproved
  - The vendor is Inactive

Source: [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 33]

Question: What must an unapproved vendor ensure before their record can be approved?
Answer: - An unapproved vendor must ensure their vendor record is activated and not inactive before it can be approved. Specifically, the record must be activated by logging in and using the “Reactivate” button, as the unapproved/vendor record that is currently inactive cannot proceed to approval. This is described in the section about “Why am I unable to update my vendor details?” where inactivity blocks final approval [Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 34].

Question: What can a vendor do to reactivate an inactive vendor record?
Answer: - To reactivate an inactive vendor record, you may do so by clicking on the “Reactivate” button upon successful login. After your vendor record is activated, you may update your vendor record details in the portal. [Document: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 34]

Question: What are the three authorisation clauses a new vendor agrees to when creating a vendor record?
Answer:
- The three authorisation clauses are listed under the “Authorization” section of the Create New Vendor flow:
  - The Government and Statutory Boards to credit payments due to me/us to the stated account. Amounts so credited would constitute valid discharge of obligations due to me/us.
  - This authorisation shall continue to be in force until I/we have notified you in writing.
  - I/We hereby request and authorise the Government and Statutory Boards to obtain confirmation/verification of information relating to me/us and/or to my/our accounts from/with the bank where the Account is maintained as stated in the form. [Source: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 4]

Question: Can a foreign individual without Singpass update their vendor record details directly on Vendors@Gov?
Answer: - No. A foreign individual who does not have Singpass cannot update their vendor record details directly on Vendors@Gov. This is stated in the section “Why am I unable to update my vendor details?” which notes that such users are not able to update vendor details in the Government Financial System (NFS@Gov) and would need to contact the appropriate liaison officer or their client agency. [Document: Create_Update_Vendor_Record.pdf, Page 34]
